site.title: Offline Toolbox
site.tagline: Private, self-contained tools that run entirely in your browser — no server, no Internet.

tools.name: API Workbench
tools.description: Build, send and save HTTP/REST requests. Collections, environments, history and OpenAPI/Swagger import — a lightweight offline alternative to Postman.

tools.name: PDF Toolbox
tools.description: Merge, split, reorder, rotate, annotate, sign, fill forms, convert and optimize PDFs. Everything is processed locally — files never leave your computer.
